    Galaxy Watch Classic8

    Behold, the Classic ahead of its time

    Introducing Galaxy Watch8 Classic, a true masterpiece perfected for modern excellence. The iconic Rotating Bezel and Quick Button deliver timeless sophistication, while the upgraded Dynamic Lug System allows for a flawless fit.

    Exceptional both inside and out, Galaxy Watch8 Classic now features the signature cushion design that unlocks new possibilities. Discover what greater things you can do with AI on Galaxy Watch8 Classic. Redefine productivity by performing tasks across different apps with simple commands. Take charge of your well-being with AI-powered health features that provide personalised insights into your sleep, workout, heart activity and more. Galaxy Watch8 Classic is your personal wellness coach that stays with you.

    Meet the next-level innovation on
    Galaxy Watch8 Classic

    New look with new possibilities

    Enhanced power for effortless health monitoring

    Get instant assistance from your wrist

    Build healthy habits with personal coaching

    • "Galaxy Watch8 Classic brings back the rotating bezel with its satisfying navigation."

      CNN Underscored

      07/2025

    • "Impressive how well Gemini on the Galaxy Watch8 handles long, stream-of-consciousness questions."

      CNET

      07/2025

    • "Samsung aims to help you become healthier by motivating you through instant feedback."

      PhoneArena

      06/2025

      Where innovation meets timeless design

      The iconic Rotating Bezel is back. A signature Classic feature, the Rotating Bezel makes Galaxy Watch8 Classic look sophisticated, much like an elegant timepiece. Not only is it aesthetically pleasing but it's also functional — turn the Rotating Bezel to enjoy smooth and intuitive scrolling. The Rotating Bezel and the new cushion design together shape Galaxy Watch8 Classic as the epitome of smartwatches.1

      Power-packed cushion design

      Unlock high-level performance with a design that blends form and function. Newly introduced to the Classic, the cushion design is all about a cutting-edge, rounded square that encases the latest smartwatch technology.

      Redesigned to fit better

      Galaxy Watch8 Classic's watch face in night view mode appears to indicate the display is clearly visible at night. The rest of the device appears and the Watch band snaps on to indicate the improved Dynamic Lug System. Watch face changes to regular mode. Wrist appears and Galaxy Watch8 Classic is attached to the wrist. The wrist is turned to indicate the upgraded fit of the Dynamic Lug System.

      Experience the most comfortable Galaxy Watch Classic yet. The improved Dynamic Lug System ensures that Galaxy Watch8 Classic fits ever so snugly on your wrist, with the angles adjusted for Galaxy Watch8 Classic to stay secure in its place. The Dynamic Lug System is also enhanced to make it easy for you to change your Watch bands in a snap. 5,6

      A touch of
      premium with Quick Button

      Newly introduced to the Classic model, the Quick Button expands the capabilities of Galaxy Watch8 Classic. The traditional watch element embodies the heritage design of a high-end timepiece. At the same time, Quick Button functions as a physical button that helps you quickly access features or launch apps with a reassuring click. 7

      Classic colours that complete any look

      Galaxy Watch8 Classic is available in two timeless colours, Black and White. The deep, rich Black exudes refinement and makes a bold statement for any occasion, while the fresh, crisp White offers a minimal, modern look. Whether dressing up for a night out or breaking a sweat with a run outdoors, Galaxy Watch8 Classic effortlessly elevates any outfit, delivering a polished and versatile look. 1

          Powerful inside and out

          • Always bright. Even in sunlight

            The new bright display on Galaxy Watch8 Classic ensures unmatched clarity in any lighting condition. Under the bright sun or in dim surroundings, the increased brightness of up to 3,000 nits delivers crisp, vibrant visuals. Track your progress while running your favourite route, check the latest score of the team you follow, monitor your heart rate status and more on the brilliant display while you're out and about. 5

          • Boosted performance, backed by 64 GB storage

            Supercharge your daily routine with the powerful 3 nm processor that supports fast performance with seamless responsiveness. Multitask or navigate apps with less lag — Galaxy Watch8 Classic helps you stay productive without slowing you down. Plus, with a large 64 GB storage, you won't be concerned about running out of space for your essential files and apps.

            Get things done, all from your wrist

            Just ask. Done

            Maximise productivity with Galaxy Watch8 Classic, even on the go. Google Gemini is your conversational and capable assistant that you can speak to naturally using your voice. Ask for help to create a message to your friend saying that you're running late, or summarise your last email out loud. You can even tell Gemini to remember important information like where you parked or which locker you used — all from your wrist. 2,3

            Rise and shine with AI-powered insights

            Energy Score

            Start your day smarter with personalised stats

            Accomplish more and feel great all day, every day with Energy Score. By tracking data like sleep time average, previous day activity and sleeping heart rate, Galaxy AI provides tailored insights and proactive tips to optimise your energy from the time you wake up to the moment you go to bed. Start strong, stay energised and finish at your best. 7,8

            Bedtime Guidance

            Form a healthy bedtime routine

            Wake up feeling ready to take on the day with Bedtime Guidance. Based on the sleep data tracked from your Galaxy Watch8 Classic, receive detailed reports on your sleep patterns to understand how much rest you truly need and the best bedtime for you. As your day nears the end, Bedtime Guidance gently nudges you to start winding down, helping you get plenty of sleep to stay sharp and engaged all day.4

            • Sleep Tracking

              Gain sleep insights and get deeper rest

              Receive in-depth insights on your rest and recovery with Sleep Tracking. Galaxy Watch8 Classic monitors your sleep stages, sleep duration, heart rate and blood oxygen level while you sleep, and Samsung Health gives you comprehensive reports. By understanding your sleep habits, you can take meaningful steps toward developing healthier practices for more restorative rest. 9

            • Sleep Coaching

              Improve your sleep with Sleep Coaching

              Sleep deeper and recharge more effectively with personalised Sleep Coaching. While you sleep, Galaxy Watch8 Classic continuously checks your sleep data and Samsung Health delivers detailed insights into your sleep patterns and habits. For three to four weeks, complete missions and receive practical tips to improve your sleep quality to wake up on the right side of the bed. 10,11,12,13

            • Sleep Apnea

              Look out for signs of sleep apnea

              With CE marked sleep apnea risk detection, detect signs of moderate to severe obstructive sleep apnea by looking for oxygen saturation dips overnight with Galaxy Watch8 Classic. In the morning review the details on the Samsung Health Monitor app. 14

              Keep moving and
              keep winning

              Running Coach

              Run at your own pace with a personal coach

              Make progress the right way with Running Coach. Start by measuring your running capacity to receive personal training that works uniquely for you. Track your records and routes with improved GPS accuracy — whether you're navigating city streets, mountain trails or forest paths. Watch your progress and get ready to cross off that marathon on your New Year's resolution list. 7,15

              • Personalised HR Zone

                Train better with Personalised HR Zone

                Work out with optimal intensity through Personalised HR Zones. Check your heart's capacity and plan exercise sessions tailored to your specific needs. During outdoor runs, keep an eye on your progress by monitoring whether you're in your target heart rate zone. Understand your body better while also making sure that you're training at the right level for peak performance. 16

              • Daily Activity

                Stay motivated with daily goals

                Close the rings and finish your day strong with Daily Activity. Set your step, calorie and activity time goals and monitor your movement from day to night. Walk, exercise or simply go about your day to reach your daily activity goals. Relish the satisfaction of completing the heart-shaped progress trackers — the victory will drive you toward your next goal.

              • Exercise Tracking

                Track your moves easily with Exercise Tracking

                Discover how far you've come on your fitness journey with Galaxy Watch8 Classic. Track data from your average pace to cadence, advanced running metrics and VO2 max to stay on top of your progress. Set out to beat your personal best to stay focused and committed to your fitness goals. 17,18,19,20

                Vascular Load

                Keep track of your heart health while you sleep

                Manage the amount of stress on your vascular system overnight with Galaxy Watch8 Classic. For the first 3 nights, Galaxy Watch8 Classic establishes your baseline measurement, then regularly tracks your vascular load and compares it to previous data, revealing trends over time. Stay on top of your overall heart health by maintaining a low vascular load to prevent heart-related diseases. 7,21,22

                • BP

                  Keep an eye on your blood pressure

                  Track your blood pressure regularly with Galaxy Watch8 Classic to keep tabs on your health. Simply calibrate your Galaxy Watch8 Classic to measure your systolic and diastolic pressure. Keep logs of the readings on Samsung Health Monitor app to make sure your heart is pumping strong. Look out for fluctuations in your heart's activity to make informed decisions such as changing your diet or scheduling a visit to the doctor's office. 23,24,25,26

                • ECG

                  Take an ECG to check your heart's rhythm

                  Get insights into your heart health with Electrocardiogram (ECG) tests. Look out for any irregularities in your heart rhythm by recording the electrical activity across your chest. Check how your heart is beating to understand your heart's condition. Keep the records of ECG results to follow trends and stay on top of your heart health. 27

                • IHRN

                  Stay alert to heart irregularities

                  Watch for irregularities in your heart rhythm with Galaxy Watch8 Classic to gain a better understanding of your heart's condition. Turn on Irregular Heart Rhythm Notification (IHRN) on Samsung Health Monitor app, and Galaxy Watch8 Classic will monitor your pulse throughout the day. If signs of irregular heart rhythm, like atrial fibrillation (AFib), are detected, you'll receive an alert prompting you to take an ECG for a detailed analysis of your heart activity. Stay informed, take control and maintain good heart health. 27

                  Antioxidant Index

                  Give a thumbs up to a balanced diet

                  Track your Antioxidant Index to take charge of your health for a more youthful future. A simple press of your thumb on the sensor measures your antioxidant index, reflecting the balance of fruits and vegetables in your diet. The higher your antioxidant index, the better your nutritional intake. Monitor your progress as you work toward slowing down the effects of aging. 7,28,29,30,31

                  Samsung Health

                  Learn more

                  • Stress

                    Maintain control of your stress level

                    Redirect your stress into productivity and strength. Stay ahead of burnout by gaining valuable insights on the level of stress you are feeling at the moment. When you feel a build up of pressure, reset with guided Breathing Exercises that are designed to help you regain the power to take on the rest of the day with renewed confidence and composure.

                  • Breathing Exercises

                    Breathe in, breathe out, stay balanced

                    Clear your mind and refocus your thoughts with guided breathing exercises that are available on Galaxy Watch8 Classic. When you need to relax and relieve tension, practice breathing by choosing from three built-in techniques. You can also create your own to help you unwind effectively after a busy day you've had.

                  • Medication

                    Get reminders to take your medications

                    Manage your medications conveniently with Galaxy Watch8 Classic. Add your medications and easily access detailed information on potential interactions between drugs, food and other lifestyle factors. Use the Reminder feature for timely notifications to make sure you never miss a dose. From daily prescriptions to the occasional supplements, stay in control of your medication schedule. 12,13,33,34

                  • Body Composition

                    Meet your fitness goals with insights

                    Continue to thrive on your fitness journey by measuring your body composition with ease. Place your fingers on Galaxy Watch8 Classic to monitor key metrics such as weight, body fat and skeletal muscle to understand the changes in your body. Based on the data, set your goals for each index and adjust your exercise plans accordingly, whether it's building more muscles or losing weight. Keep moving forward with motivational messages from Galaxy Watch8 Classic. 17,32,35

                  • AGEs index

                    Check your AGEs index overnight

                    Optimise your metabolism by checking Advanced Glycation End-products (AGEs) index. Galaxy Watch8 Classic tracks your AGEs index overnight and shows the results in a simple bar graph. A high AGEs index indicates potential health issues like cardiovascular disease or high blood pressure, signaling a need for dietary changes. A low AGEs index reflects a balanced diet. Get practical tips on how to incorporate low-glycemic foods into your diet to keep your AGEs index low and support overall health.36

                    The all-new One UI 8 Watch

                    Unleash the full potential of One UI 8 Watch with its bold, simple redesign. Instantly access the information that matters most to you with the multi-info tile and streamlined notifications. N'oubliez pas d'utiliser le chargeur d'origine fourni avec votre produit Samsung, et évitez de charger votre appareil à des températures extrêmes.                               [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Overall much more refined and smooth experience with a snappy interface. It feels like Samsung has finally matured the Galaxy watch series from a teen into an adult with the polished silver square frame and a more premium look. The weight isn't off-putting but you definitely know it's there. There's not much Samsung specific innovation on top of WearOS so software wise is consistent with other watches in this category. The screen is bright and crisp with no delays in responses. I am disappointed that the battery life still struggles to get past 2 days - the Galaxy watch 5 Pro has the same stamina and is 3 years older.                               [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] The Galaxy Watch 8 Classic is hands down the best smartwatch I’ve used so far. The rotating bezel is not just nostalgic—it’s incredibly practical, especially during workouts or when wearing gloves. The build quality feels premium, the screen is bright and crisp, and the slimmer design makes it surprisingly comfortable despite the larger size. I’m impressed with the new health features like Vascular Load and the Gemini AI integration—it feels more like a personal coach than just a watch. Battery life is decent, lasting me close to two days, though I wish it charged a bit faster. Overall, it’s a big step up in both performance and polish.
